Players Committee card image of [[Han Solo, Optimistic General]], errata card marked “E1”, printing: “May be targeted instead of a Resistance character by I Want That Map. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Your [Endor] scouts are destiny +1. Cancels Kylo's game text here. During battle with Chewie or [Endor] Leia, may add one destiny to total power.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/eef4ca7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/hansolooptimisticgeneral.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/hansolooptimisticgeneral.png] as of commit eef4ca7 “Errata” (27 November 2021).
